notes.title: Dark Light: Act 1 (Available Now!)
notes.content:
[h2]The first act of Dark Light is now available and it's free![/h2]

[h3]Set sail on a post-death journey alongside Mio, a young girl surrounded by death, who must navigate through many ups and downs as she is carried to the Underworld.[/h3]
